name: Cylinder Carousel
description: Vertical 3D cylinder of image tiles that you spin by dragging or swiping up and down, with perspective depth and a short hint caption above.
contents: Ring of image tiles arranged around a 3D cylinder
Invisible drag zone over the cylinder
behavior: Drag or swipe vertically to rotate the cylinder around the X axis with eased transition
Tile radius is computed from tile size, gap and image count
Touch moves on the body are blocked while dragging
Tiles beyond the seventh load lazily

props.name: tipText
props.default: Use your finger or mouse to swipe up and down :)

editableByProps: Images, tile size, gap, perspective and depth
Background and hint colors, hint text, image alt text
fixed: Adds a non-passive touchmove listener on document.body that blocks scrolling while dragging, removed on unmount
Drag zone is fixed at 120px wide and up to 468px tall
